description:
Welcome to Sunshine Spa & Beauty Clinic

At Sunshine Spa & Beauty Clinic, we believe that true beauty is a balance of clinical precision and natural grace. Located at 74 Trần Trọng Cung, P. Tân Thuận Đông, Q.7, our clinic offers expert RN-led medical aesthetics and wellness services tailored to your unique goals.

Our philosophy is rooted in patient education, safety, and personalized care. Every treatment is a personalized journey, ensuring your health and well-being are our highest priority.

Our Services

We specialize in a comprehensive range of medical-grade treatments, including:

Neurotoxins & Fillers: Expertly administered treatments designed to restore your natural beauty with clinical precision and long-lasting results.

Advanced Skin Treatments: From microneedling to chemical peels, we offer medical-grade skincare to address your specific concerns.

Our Commitment to You

Clinical Precision: Every procedure is performed by a licensed RN with a focus on anatomical accuracy and medical-grade results.

Personalized Care: We prioritize your individual goals and medical history to create a safe, customized treatment plan.

Medical Integrity: Our RN-led philosophy ensures that every treatment is backed by clinical credibility and patient education.

Safe & Ethical: We uphold the highest standards of medical ethics, ensuring your safety and long-term health are our top priority.

Your First Visit

Step 1 - Consultation and Assessment: We discuss your goals and medical history, and our founder and nurse injector will assess your face in person.

Step 2 - Your Plan, in Plain Language: We discuss what may help and what won't, what it costs, and what to expect.

Step 3 - Treatment: We treat only when you are ready and consent is given. Some patients treat the same day; plenty go home and think about it first.

Step 4 - Follow-up: You'll hear from us afterward, and your follow-up appointment is booked before you leave. If a series of treatments is right for you, we can map out a full treatment schedule together.
